sites: resid_mid.L = input of layers[L].post_attention_layernorm; resid_post.L = resid_mid.L + output of layers[L].mlp; position 0 dropped
vocab: 16,384 groups x 4 directions, top-24 groups per token by written norm, 50M tokens per layer
molt: 41,484 gated low-rank atoms (ranks 1-16, rank budget 131,072), recipe M1w (fixed mean-gate map, whitened gate input), 29.3M tokens per layer
fvu: fraction of variance unexplained on held-out tokens of the training mixture (vocab: per site; molt: pooled over the four held-out sets)
splice: next-token loss on 100 fineweb-edu documents x 256 tokens (outside the training mixture) with one replacement at the layer: dce = CE - CE clean (nats), kl = KL(clean || spliced); see statescope/splice.py for the arms
